typedef NS_ENUM(NSInteger, Kind) {
    KindA,
    KindB
};

@interface Greeter : NSObject

+ (instancetype)shared;
- (void)greet:(NSString *)name;

@end

@implementation Greeter

+ (instancetype)shared {
    return [[Greeter alloc] init];
}

- (void)greet:(NSString *)name {
    if (name) {
        NSLog(@"hi %@", name);
    }
}

- (NSInteger)classify:(NSInteger)n {
    if (n < 0) {
        return -1;
    } else if (n == 0) {
        return 0;
    }
    return 1;
}

- (BOOL)isValid:(NSString *)name withFlag:(BOOL)flag {
    return name && flag;
}

@end

int plainAdd(int a, int b) {
    return a + b;
}
